items.title: Nike Is Down About 80% From Its Peak and Just Told Investors Sales Will Fall Again
items.summary: Nike's stock has collapsed from its highs, analysts still show a 30% upside gap, and management just guided earnings far below what Wall Street expected. The math behind those price targets tells a very different story.

items.title: Deckers Outdoor (DECK) Stock Looks Cheap Following Its 2027 Sales Cut
items.summary: Deckers Outdoor has seen its share price come under pressure this year, and that slide puts fresh focus on a simple question for investors who follow the footwear group. Do the earnings that Deckers generates today, and the expectations tied to them, justify where the stock now trades? The share price is down 26.1% year to date, which raises the question of whether the current valuation is still in step with the business's earnings power.
